assertions: a failed message keeps its head-of-line position and is retried on the next dispatch_all run
a message moves to dead_letters after exactly MAX_RETRIES failed attempts
a message on an unknown channel goes to dead_letters immediately and is never silently dropped
following messages never overtake a retrying message (strict FIFO)
dispatch_all returns the number of messages delivered in that run
only dispatcher.py may be modified; baseline tests stay untouched
